feeds.title: Once Upon a Journey
feeds.description: Welcome to our lesbian lifestyle and travel blog! We're Roxanne + Maartje: 2 girls in love w/ each other, the world, writing, and photography! You'll find our blog highly visual, as we believe we can tell our travels and tips best through written and visual content!

feeds.title: Travel with Mei and Kerstin
feeds.description: Welcome to Travel with Mei & Kerstin! We're a married lesbian couple from Luxembourg, who's been exploring the world together since 2002. Exploring places we haven't been to yet. Understanding different cultures. Learning about other civilizations. And putting our experiences, ideas, and memories down in words. These are passions that united us when we met. And these are the passions that still bond us. Road trips. City trips. Urban escapes. Weekend getaways. Or just a walk in the woods...The more we travel, the more we love it.

feeds.title: Globetrotter Girls
feeds.description: Globetrotter Girls is all about travel adventures, travel tips, travel guides and travel photography from all our global travel adventures. Her mission is to inspire curiosity about the world and provide the tips and tools gained first-hand to help you see as much of the world as you can for yourself. Follow this blog and get travel tips and guides from travel adventures.

feeds.title: Les Talk, More Travel
feeds.description: Les Talk, More Travel is about local and international adventures for adventurous queers, lovers of the Pacific Northwest, and other interested humans! Les, I'm Leslie, a Canadian currently living in Victoria, British Columbia. Occasionally I like to write about LGBT-related issues and lesbian travel.

feeds.title: Lez See the World Blog
feeds.description: Founded in 2016 by married lesbian couple Steph and Katie Burlton, Lez See the World is a queer digital media company based in Vancouver, BC. Specializing in queer travel and lifestyle content, Steph and Katie have combined their professional skillsets and years of industry experience to build their business. They believe in visibility, and strive to share their experiences in the hopes that it will encourage lesbians to see the world!

feeds.title: Bounding Over Our Steps
feeds.description: We're the traveling team of Ligeia, a US-American, and Mindy, a Canadian, currently calling Florida, USA home, where Ligeia is an ESL language instructor and Mindy works in freelance web design, both professions allowing for a nomadic life. We started this blog way back in December 2005, with the primary intention of keeping our friends and family up to date with what was going on with us. Today, we hope to reach a broader audience that is not only interested in our daily lives, but also fellow travelers that share one or more similar interests.

feeds.title: Gabriela Here and There Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Gabriela - an adventurous solo female traveler, blogger, and photographer. I'm on a quest to visit every country in the world and have already seen over half of the world (100+ countries). In this blog, I share stories and photos of my adventures, destination guides, and vegan travel tips. A lot of my content here focuses on Africa, and in a way, my blog has become an Africa travel blog highlighting some quite unusual destinations there.

feeds.title: The Freedom Travellers
feeds.description: At The Freedom Travellers, we love creative & clean designs and want to bring new ideas to Themeforest. We are a creative ecosystem of sites and services for digital assets and creative people. Our goal is to help enhance your creativity while helping our community to make a living from theirs.
